nonIndexablePagesDetail: Pages that exist in dist but are deliberately absent from site-urls.txt and the sitemap: 22 x 404 (root + 21 non-English locales) + 1 Netlify forms placeholder (/__forms). Invariant checked in verify-baseline: htmlTotal - site-urls.txt lines === this number. Update it deliberately, with a reason, when the set changes (e.g. English-only posts add 21 fallback shims each, which do stay out of the list).
updateReason: Publishes 15 English-only B2B posts (GPSR, Japan PSE, Australia TGA/ARTG, UN38.3, declaration of conformity, Korea KC, Russia EAC, IEC 62133-2, UKCA/CE, SASO/SABER, HS code, warranty terms, quality agreement, carton CBM, export documents) ahead of their 21-locale translations. Measured effect: en 77 -> 92 posts; each English-only post also emits 21 meta-refresh shims whose canonical points at the English URL, so htmlTotal 3433 -> 3763 (15 real pages + 315 shims), site-urls.txt 3410 -> 3425 (+15 only, the shims stay out of the list), and the urlList delta 23 -> 338. blogPerLocale is 92 for every locale because the shims are counted as blog pages in dist. sitemapCanonicalMismatch declares the 315 shims the sitemap guard must tolerate; it is read by scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs when the environment variable is absent, so local and CI builds agree. Backfill plan: translate the five highest-intent posts first (GPSR, Japan PSE, HS code, warranty terms, carton CBM) in all 21 locales, then the remaining ten. Each translated post removes 21 shims; when the count reaches zero, delete sitemapCanonicalMismatch and set nonIndexablePages back to 23.
